fullContent:
Brihat Kasturi Bhairav Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwara Rogadhikara – 723 – 730 
 Brihat Kasturi Bhairav Ras is an Ayurvedic tablet. It is used in the treatment of diabetes, urinary tract diseases, chronic fever etc. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Mrigamada – Musk 
 Karpoora – Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Tamra Bhasma – Bhasma (calx) of Copper 
 Dhataki – Fire flame bush (flower) – Woodfordia fruticosa 
 Atmagupta – Velvet Bean (seed) –    Mucuna pruriens 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Gold 
 Rajata Bhasma –     Bhasma (Calx) of Silver 
 Mukta Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Pearl 
 Pravala Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Coral 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Iron 
 Patha – Cyclea peltata 
 Vidanga – False black pepper (fruit) – Embelia ribes 
 Musta – Nut grass (root) – Cyperus rotundus 
 Shunti – Ginger (rhizome) – Zingiber officinalis 
 Hrivera –   Pavonia odorata 
 Shuddha Haratala – Purified Orpiment – Arsenic tri sulphide 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Bhasma (calx) of Mica 
 Amalaki – Indian Gooseberry – Emblica officinalis 
 Arka – Calotropis procera – quantity sufficient. 
 
 How to Make? 
 Make fine powder of above ingredients and grounded with the juice extract of Amalaki and arka then made into paste and finally pills are prepared. 
 Dosage 
 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is traditionally administered along with honey, Bael root powder, and cumin powder. 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes 
 Urinary tract disease 
 Liver disease 
 Diarrhea 
 All types of fever 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 
 Side Effects 
 Note – Avoid Self-medication with this medicine. It may cause severe side effects as it contains heavy metals that may prove to be dangerous. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision in prescribed dose for limited period of time or as advised by doctor. Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effects. 
 It is best avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
